title: Comic Strips
text:
Comic strips are short stories with pictures. They are usually in a row of small boxes called panels. Each panel has drawings and short words in a bubble. Many people read comic strips in newspapers every day.

Some comic strips are funny, and some are sad. The characters in a comic strip often appear again and again from day to day. Children and adults both enjoy reading them. Many comic strips are also published in books.

questions.text: How are comic strips usually arranged?
options: In a row of small boxes

questions.text: Where do many people read comic strips every day?
What is the main purpose of the pictures and short words in a comic strip?
Why might the same characters appear again and again in a comic strip?
options: So readers get to know them
Because the characters are always sad

paragraph_translations: Komiksy to krótkie historyjki z obrazkami. Zwykle są ułożone w rzędzie małych ramek zwanych kadrami. Każdy kadr ma rysunki i krótkie słowa w dymku. Wiele osób czyta komiksy w gazetach każdego dnia.

Niektóre komiksy są zabawne, a niektóre smutne. Bohaterowie w komiksie często pojawiają się znowu i znowu z dnia na dzień. Dzieci i dorośli lubią je czytać. Wiele komiksów jest też wydawanych w książkach.
